purpose: Controlled one-time local catalogue backfill; not a runtime ingestion source.
catalogue_semantics: Each product is a marketed phone plus a specific storage configuration. RAM is included only when the exact RAM/storage pairing was independently verified. Colours, sellers and carriers never create products.
